subject: Re: NovaHealth evaluation & rollout plan — pricing exception request
messages:
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@novahealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evaluation & rollout plan for NovaHealth — timeline and pricing

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo today — the team at NovaHealth is excited about Redwood. Procurement has a tight window and would like a formal mutual action plan (MAP) we can attach to our budget approval packet. High level: a 30-day evaluation pilot (10 seats, 100k tokens), performance gate at 3% hallucination threshold, then a phased ramp targeting 1M tokens/month by end of Q1.

From a commercial standpoint, we are asking for a ramp credit and an introductory discount to offset pilot costs. Specifically: a one-time ramp credit and a 30% introductory discount for the first 2 months of production, transitioning to a committed discount after we hit the 1M token commit. Procurement needs to see the MAP and the price exception sign-off by Oct 26 to make the current budget cycle.

Attached: NovaHealth_Rollout_REQ.pdf (requirements + procurement timeline)

Can you send the MAP and indicate what approvals are required on Redwood's side for the requested ramp credit?

Thanks,
Sarah Li
Head of Product Ops — NovaHealth
[sarah.li@novahealth.com]
[Attachment: NovaHealth_Rollout_REQ.pdf]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@novahealth.com>
Cc: NovaHealth Procurement <procurement@novahealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation & rollout plan for NovaHealth — timeline and pricing

Hi Sarah — great to chat earlier. Attached is an initial MAP draft that aligns with what we discussed, with milestone definitions and accept/reject gates for the pilot. I added an illustrative pricing table that shows:
- Pilot (30 days): discounted rate, covered by a one-time ramp credit (proposal below)
- Month 1-2 production: introductory discount applied to usage above pilot baseline
- Post-commit (>=1M tokens/mo): committed discount tier

We'd like to propose a one-time ramp credit of $15,000 and a 30% introductory discount for the first two production months, contingent on a 12-month committed purchase after the pilot. I'm going to escalate the discount/credit request internally and will loop in our finance and sales leadership — I expect to have a firm answer tomorrow.

Attached: Redwood_MAP_NovaHealth_v1.pdf (MAP + pricing table)

If procurement needs an early-term sheet for legal to review, let me know and I'll push one for signature.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri yom_das@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redwood_MAP_NovaHealth_v1.pdf]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: FW: NovaHealth — credit exception request + MAP (deal DEAL-8853)

Team — forwarding NovaHealth's requirements and the MAP I sent this morning. Quick summary and ask:
- Account: NovaHealth (health-tech provider)
- Proposed economics: $15k one-time ramp credit; 30% intro discount for production months 1-2; then committed discount (20%) at >=1M tokens/mo with 12-mo commit. Year 1 ARR expected ~ $120k if ramp goes to plan.
- Business rationale: strategic win in healthcare vertical with potential reference & marketplace integration. Procurement needs sign-off on pricing exception by Oct 26 to close this budget cycle.

Ask: I need sign-off on the $15k ramp credit and the 30% introductory discount (or a counter). Per our policy: credits >$10k require CFO review; discounts >25% need VP approval; anything that materially changes revenue recognition or SLOs needs Legal. Can we confirm approvals and whether legal should prepare a redline?

Attachments: NovaHealth_Rollout_REQ.pdf; Redwood_MAP_NovaHealth_v1.pdf

Notes: if we reduce the one-time credit to $10k we stay within standard finance thresholds; happy to trade to a 25% intro discount. Would like to keep the customer on a 12-mo committed term post-pilot.

Thanks — Priyom
[Attachment: NovaHealth_Rollout_REQ.pdf, Redwood_MAP_NovaHealth_v1.pdf]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: NovaHealth — credit exception request + MAP (deal DEAL-8853)

Folks — reviewed the numbers. A few clarifying points before final sign-off:
1) Is the $15k credit refundable or amortized against committed ARR? Need to understand accounting treatment for ASC/IFRS.
2) What are the precise breakpoints for the committed discount (is the 1M token commit firm; are there penalties or makegoods if performance gates fail?).
3) Can Legal confirm we have standard SLOs and audit log retention requirements for a healthcare deployment (PII/PHI guardrails)?

From a finance perspective I can approve a one-time credit up to $12k provided we get a 12-month committed term and a clause that the credit is clawed back if the commit isn't met by month 6. I'm also comfortable with a 25% introductory discount instead of 30% as a trade-off. Anything above $12k needs explicit VP + CFO sign-off (Aditya to note for CEO-level exceptions).

Please respond with suggested redlines and I will route through Finance for formal sign-off.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Chief Financial Officer | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T11:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: NovaHealth — credit exception request + MAP (deal DEAL-8853)

Thanks Rishi — I agree with Finance's approach. To keep the deal moving given their procurement deadline, VP Sales approves the following conditional terms:
- One-time ramp credit: $12,000 (amortized against ARR; clawback clause if commit not met by month 6)
- Introductory discount: 25% for the first two production months
- Commit: 1M tokens/month for 12 months to qualify for the committed discount tier thereafter

Aditya — looping you for awareness. If you want to approve the original ask ($15k / 30% intro) for strategic reasons, say the word and I'll mark as CEO exception. Otherwise I'll proceed with the Finance-approved terms and instruct Legal to prepare a term sheet.

Laura Bennett
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Subject: Approved terms & MAP (NovaHealth / DEAL-8853)

Hi Sarah — quick update and next steps. Internal approvals are in and Legal will generate the term sheet for signature. Approved conditional terms (per our discussion and finance review):

- Introductory discount: 25% for production months 1–2
- Committed pricing tier: 20% discount when NovaHealth sustains >=1M tokens/month on a 12-month contract

Aditya (CEO) and Laura (VP Sales) are copied for transparency; Rishi (CFO) approved the finance terms. We have also opened a DocuSign envelope for an expedited signature once Legal posts the final term sheet. Links/attachments below.
